Interest is figured daily on the balance, as most auto loans do. Paying half the monthly amount every two weeks adds up to 26 half-payments, about one extra monthly payment a year.

Check how your lender applies payments

The savings only happen if each half-payment is credited when it arrives. Some lenders hold a half-payment until the rest of the monthly amount comes in, and some third-party biweekly services charge fees. Ask your lender before you switch.
